problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting packages to load onto a cargo drone. The available packages are:
* Package 1: weight 47kg, revenue 110 credits
* Package 2: weight 4kg, revenue 32 credits
* Package 3: weight 18kg, revenue 192 credits
* Package 4: weight 11kg, revenue 252 credits
* Package 5: weight 20kg, revenue 206 credits
* Package 6: weight 16kg, revenue 22 credits
* Package 7: weight 10kg, revenue 291 credits
* Package 8: weight 18kg, revenue 98 credits
* Package 9: weight 26kg, revenue 165 credits
* Package 10: weight 40kg, revenue 145 credits
* Package 11: weight 2kg, revenue 187 credits
* Package 12: weight 7kg, revenue 298 credits
* Package 13: weight 24kg, revenue 185 credits
* Package 14: weight 34kg, revenue 177 credits
* Package 15: weight 46kg, revenue 124 credits
* Package 16: weight 47kg, revenue 269 credits
* Package 17: weight 16kg, revenue 139 credits
* Package 18: weight 2kg, revenue 272 credits
* Package 19: weight 11kg, revenue 171 credits
* Package 20: weight 46kg, revenue 276 credits
* Package 21: weight 48kg, revenue 116 credits
* Package 22: weight 40kg, revenue 145 credits
* Package 23: weight 23kg, revenue 135 credits
* Package 24: weight 26kg, revenue 186 credits
* Package 25: weight 35kg, revenue 203 credits
* Package 26: weight 21kg, revenue 179 credits
* Package 27: weight 43kg, revenue 233 credits
* Package 28: weight 26kg, revenue 159 credits
* Package 29: weight 15kg, revenue 284 credits

The drone has a maximum payload capacity of 505 kg. Choose the combination of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
